subject: two dimensional interaction between two covariates

messages.author: 79b31c930c78e998
messages.subject: two dimensional interaction between two covariates
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to add to my model a non-linear interaction between two covariates. Lets say that I have the independent variable y and two covariates x1 and x2. First, I know that the two variables have a non-linear effect on y. Thus, I want
to keep this non-linear effect in the interaction between the covariates x1 and x2 using a 2d spline surface or similar surface.

How can I run the following model with INLA:

y= f(x1)+f(x2)+f(x1)*f(x2)


where f(x1)*f(x2) is the non-linear interaction.

In BayesX, this can be included in the model using pspline2dimrw1 or pspline2dimrw2 but I cannot find any tutorial to do the same in INLA.

Thank in advance for your help.

Best,

Donal

> to keep this non-linear effect in the interaction between the
> covariates x1 and x2 using a 2d spline surface or similar surface.

Hi,

this is surprisingly difficult to do. can use the spde-model, for which
a limiting case is the 2d spline, or the rw2d model which place this
(in-efficiently) on a lattice. 

sorry...
